package_name: Kinnaur-Spiti Connect (7D) — The Road Less Traveled

itinerary.day_1: Shimla → Reckong Peo (Drive: 195 km). Places: Narkanda, Reckong Peo. Activities: Narkanda apple belt; Reckong Peo arrival.
itinerary.day_2: Sangla & Chitkul (Drive: 80 km). Places: Sangla, Rakcham, Chitkul. Activities: Sangla Kamru Fort; Chitkul last village.
itinerary.day_3: Chitkul → Tabo (Drive: 190 km). Places: Nako Village, Tabo Monastery. Activities: Nako Lake monastery; Tabo murals.
itinerary.day_4: Tabo → Kaza (Drive: 45 km). Places: Pin Valley National Park, Kaza. Activities: Pin Valley walk; Key Monastery sunset.
itinerary.day_5: Spiti Village Circuit (Drive: 80 km). Places: Langza Village, Hikkim, Komic, Kibber Village. Activities: Langza fossils; Hikkim PO; Komic gompa; Kibber.
itinerary.day_6: Chandratal (Drive: 115 km). Places: Kunzum Pass, Chandratal Lake. Activities: Kunzum Pass (4,590m); Chandratal Moon Lake (4,300m).
itinerary.day_7: → Manali (Drive: 115 km). Places: Atal Tunnel Viewpoint, Sissu. Activities: Atal Tunnel crossing; Sissu waterfall.
